subject: Plan portability, seat-swap proposal, and feature bundling for MedLytics

Subject: Re: Plan portability, seat-swap proposal, and feature bundling for MedLytics

Hi Olga,

Thanks for earlier context in the demo — quick ask from our side as we start budgeting for the fall: we want to rework how seats are allocated across two product teams (Ingest and Clinical QA). Right now we're on the Growth tier with the Insights add-on. Two specific asks:  

- Is it possible to temporarily move 40 seats from Ingest to Clinical QA for a 3-month pilot (Sept-Nov) and then revert back without a full downgrade/upgrade cycle?
- Can we remove Insights from 25 seats to reduce costs, but keep it for 15 seats with a bundled discount? If so, what would that pricing look like?

Also: we have a security review that wants confirmation on data portability between tiers and whether any historical logs are tied to a specific feature add-on. Laura (cc) will coordinate procurement and needs a draft contract to review redlines.

Thanks — want to get this nailed down before our quarterly planning meeting on Aug 18.

Best,
Javier
Director of Product, MedLytics

High-level next steps:  
1) Ben proposes a pricing sketch (we'll include prorated charges for the 3-month swap).
2) Karthik confirms any data/log constraints and whether Insights telemetry remains accessible when the feature is removed from a seat.
3) I’ll prepare a short MAP and a contract draft for Laura to review.

I put a tentative MAP in the attachments and will follow up with a proper pricing sheet. Can we aim to finalize by Aug 12 so procurement has time before your Aug 18 planning?

Subject: Re: Plan portability, seat-swap proposal, and feature bundling for MedLytics

Javier / team — quick pricing breakdown for the two options Olga outlined. Numbers are illustrative; final will be in the attached pricing sheet.

Option A — Reversible seat-swap (3 months) - Move 40 seats to Clinical QA for Sept-Nov, revert Dec 1.
- No change to base per-seat rate; we prorate monthly usage. One-time administrative fee: $2,500.
- Estimated incremental cost (proration + admin): $3,100 total for the 3 months.

Option B — Permanent feature re-allocation + bundled Insights discount - Keep Insights on 15 seats; remove from 25 seats.
- Standard Insights add-on is $350/seat/mo. With a 12-month commitment on those 15 seats we can offer 20% discount on the add-on ($280/seat/mo).
- For the 25 seats without Insights: those remain at base Growth tier rate; we can apply a seat-level credit of $50/seat/mo on your invoice for the next 6 months as a concession while you evaluate.

Combinable approach: Do the reversible swap for Sep-Nov and commit to the 15-seat Insights bundle starting Dec 1 to lock the discounted add-on rate. If you commit to an annualized bundle for the 15 seats, we can also offer a $10k onboarding credit that applies to your first invoice.

I'll include line-item math in pricing-options-medlytics.xlsx. Let me know if you prefer the proration done by day or by month; day-level proration adds precision but complicates billing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-options-medlytics.xlsx (spreadsheet with scenarios)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 06 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plan portability, seat-swap proposal, and feature bundling for MedLytics

Quick technical notes on portability and logs so procurement has clear expectations:  

- Data portability: model outputs, KV caches, and customer-side prefixes are not tied to add-ons. If you remove Insights from a seat, transcripts and inference outputs remain accessible in your workspace.
- Telemetry/logs: Insights adds additional analytic metadata (anonymized usage events). If you remove the feature from a seat, we retain telemetry for 90 days by default for rollout/quality checks, unless you request longer retention (we can extend via support SLA).
- Billing mappings: seats are soft-mapped to features in our billing system. The reversible seat-swap will create a temporary allocation entry and does not create a permanent contract amendment if you revert within the defined window.

One caution: if the 25 seats you remove from Insights are later re-enrolled after >90 days, some aggregated Insights metrics may require re-ingestion to show historical continuity. We can provide a re-ingestion path as part of the MAP if historical continuity is required.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk Laura through the retention & telemetry details.

—Karthik
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference

1) Can the reversible swap be executed via our existing contract amendment (no new SOW)?
2) Please confirm the estimated proration method (we prefer day-level proration).
3) We need the draft contract and the MAP for internal approval; Laura will review and route to legal for redlines.

If you can get a single PDF with the MAP, priced scenarios, and contract draft by Aug 12, we should be on track for the Aug 18 planning sync.

-Javier
